rules.name: Cavalry
rules.text: Can dismount and fight on foot as infantry, from which point none of these rules apply - need to replace mounted figures with non-mounted figures. When cavalry, moves 9" at an Advance, 18" at Run. Cannot enter buildings or board transport vehicles unless they have dismounted. Cannot gain advantages of Down, and their cover saves are always reduced by 1. Can escape as a recce vehicle (at normal speed, not double speed). Can dismount as part of Advance move - cannot remount. Can only fire pistol or carbine (treated as pistol) when mounted. While mounted, cavalry have Tough Fighters special rule (p122- When fails to damage in close quarters against enemy infantry or artillery units, it can re-roll the failed rolls to damage). Can regroup up to 2D6" after combat.

rules.name: Di Corsa!
rules.text: The unit may re-roll failed Advance and Run order tests. This rule does not apply when coming onto the table from reserve or outflanking, and it also does not apply for assaults.

rules.name: Falgore!
rules.text: The unit can re-roll failed rolls to hit when assaulting vehicles.

rules.name: Fieldcraft (including light artillery)
rules.text: (v3 page 120) Treat rough ground as open ground instead. (v3 page 22 AoI) (AoI and AoGB Chindits: this applies to light howitzers and light anti-tank guns too, but not to other artillery units).

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.text: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn (as long as the Intelligence Officer is on the table), the Officer may act on intelligence gathered about the enemy force before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6, a Veteran Officer receives a +1 modifier on the roll, an Inexperienced one receives a -1 modifier. On a 4+, the player using this ability may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players are doing this in the same turn and both succeed in this roll, the results cancel out and the dice is randomly drawn, as normal. Only one Officer in the entire force may have Intelligence training.

rules.name: Milizia Volontaria
rules.text: Units have the following rule for free (this rule replaces the Green special rule for Inexperienced units): Immediately before the opponent rolls to hit when shooting the unit, or for casualties in close combat versus the unit, the controlling player rolls a D6: • 1–2: the section loses its will to fight and gains Shirkers • 3–4: the section remains the same and fights on as normal • 5–6: the section is filled with patriotic bravery and gains Fanatics

rules.name: Motorbikes
rules.text: Moves at 12" at an Advance and 24" at a Run with the same movement rules and restrictions as Wheeled vehicles, except they may make any number of turns as they move. Cannot enter builders or board transports. Do not benefit from any advantage from going/being Down. Can react by making and escape move in the same way as recce (at normal move, not double speed). Can dismount as part of any Advance move and fight as infantry, but cannot remount. Motorcycle riders cannot shoot while moving. Cannot assault and if assaulted can make an escape move as for other recce vehicles. If attacked at close quarters each man fights as infantry (including sidecar passengers if equipped). Regroup 2D6" rather than D6".

rules.name: Stubborn
rules.text: If forced to take a morale check, they ignore negative morale modifiers from pin markers. Remember that order tests are not morale checks, and are therefore modified as normal.

rules.name: Tank hunters
rules.text: If a tank hunter unit wins an assault and scores damage against an armoured vehicle, the effect is resolved on the Damage Result table as for a normal anti-tank penetration rather than as for superficial damage. In addition, these troops don't suffer from the Tank Fear rule when assaulting fully-enclosed armoured vehicles.

rules.name: Winter Equipment
rules.text: Any infantry unit may take skis for no additional cost. An infantry unit equipped with skis ignore all negative movement effects related to snow or ice in scenarios that introduce them. Any artillery units may be upgraded to mounted guns for no additional cost, but you must remove all gun shields from any gun upgraded in this way. Any unit with this upgrade is not affected by difficult ground like other artillery. Instead, it may move through difficult ground in the same manner as infantry, and ignores all negative movement effects related to snow or ice in scenarios that introduce them.

armyRules.name: Ferrea Mole, Ferreo Cuore (Iron Hulls, Iron Hearts)
armyRules.text: Any Italian vehicle with this special rule in its entry may re-roll failed Advance and Run order tests. This rule does not apply when coming onto the table from reserve or outflanking, and it also does not apply for assaults.

armyRules.name: Alzo Zero! (Open Sights!)
armyRules.text: All Italian artillery units may reroll any failed morale checks.

armyRules.name: Mixed Quality
armyRules.text: All Inexperienced Italian infantry units have the Green special rule.

armyRules.name: Defensive Strategy
armyRules.text: During the first turn of the game, the enemy cannot order their units on the table to Run as they cautiously probe the terrain in front of the Italian line for minefields and make their way across barbed wire. Enemy units in first wave are exempt and can be ordered to Run as normal to enter the table. Any of your Regular or Veteran unit that is set up on the table before Turn 1 may start the game already in Ambush. If you decide to do so, set one of your order dice in place next to them as you deploy them, as if you had ordered them to Ambush, before drawing the first order die on Turn 1. In scenarios that require an attacker and a defender the Italian player may choose if they want to be defender or not, except if both forces are Italian, in which case this rule has no effect.
